streams via WS/SSE) WorkflowRunRequest → WorkflowRunResponse key + tenant GET /api/runs R/runs.py:list_runs List run logs (workflow, limit query) → list[RunSummaryModel] key + tenant GET /api/runs/summary R/runs.py:runs_summary Aggregate stats (workflow query) → RunsSummaryResponse key + tenant GET /api/runs/{filename} R/runs.py:get_run One run log (StepResultRecord steps) → untyped dict (404 documented) key + tenant GET /api/runs/{filename}/evaluation R/runs.py:get_run_evaluation Stored evaluation detail → RunEvaluationDetailResponse key + tenant POST /api/runs/{filename}/evaluate R/runs.py:evaluate_run Re-score a run (mutates the run log in place) RunReEvaluationRequest \| None → RunEvaluationDetailResponse key + tenant POST /api/eval/compare R/runs.py:compare_runs Head-to-head rubric comparison of two runs EvalComparisonRequest → EvalComparisonResponse key + tenant GET /api/runs/{run_id}/stream R/runs.py:stream_run_events SSE (text/event-stream) replay of run events; docs.title: 3.2 Streaming: SSE and WebSocket
docs.text:
Channel Endpoint Direction Event types (type field) Evidence WebSocket /ws/execution/{run_id} server → client; client frames are read and ignored (await websocket.receive_text() loop) First (only if AGENTIC_TRACING): trace_context {traceparent, tracestate?}; then replayed buffer; then live ExecutionEvent union: workflow_start, step_start, step_end, token_delta, step_complete, step_error, workflow_end, error, evaluation_start, evaluation_complete, approval_required, approval_decision S/websocket.py:480-516, 645-655; agentic_v2/contracts/events.py:16-156 SSE GET /api/runs/{run_id}/stream server → client same run events fanned out from ConnectionManager._sse_listeners, plus keepalive S/websocket.py:89-103, 417; R/runs.py:628-659 SSE POST /api/chat server → client (data: <json>\n\n) token, route, media (png/jpeg/webp/gif), done, error agentic_v2/contracts/chat.py:209-249; R/chat.py:269-309

WebSocket details: - Terminal events that clear the replay buffer: workflow_end, error (S/websocket.py:110, 324). - Replay store (late joiners): ReplayStore Protocol with InMemoryReplayStore, RedisReplayStore, SqliteReplayStore (S/replay_store.py:124,170,229,442), chosen by REPLAY_STORE_BACKEND. - Close codes: 1008 for disallowed origin, query-string ?token= (deprecated, rejected), missing/invalid key, or per-IP lockout (S/websocket.py:520-600). - Per-IP auth throttle shared with HTTP (AuthThrottle, S/auth.py:79-204): defaults 5 failures / 60 s window / 300 s lockout via AGENTIC_AUTH_LOCKOUT_*. - Origin policy (S/auth.py:294-320): no Origin header allowed; same-host allowed; any localhost/127.0.0.1 port allowed; otherwise AGENTIC_CORS_ORIGINS (or _DEFAULT_CORS_ORIGINS). - Dead client message: UI useNodeConfigUpdate sends {type:"node_config_update", step_name, config} over the same socket (ui/src/hooks/useNodeConfigUpdate.ts:77-81), but the server loop discards all inbound text, so that feature has no server effect. The hook is also in ui_inventory.unused_candidates.

docs.title: 3.3 API ↔ UI cross-check
docs.text:
UI HTTP client is agentic-workflows-v2/ui/src/api/client.ts (BASE = "/api", all calls via fetchJSON, plus a hand-rolled SSE reader in sendChat, client.ts:498). WebSocket client is ui/src/api/websocket.ts:49 (/ws/${pathPrefix}/${runId}, default prefix execution). ui_inventory.json api_calls captured only 2 literal paths (/api/health, /api/), so the matrix below was built by reading client.ts directly.

Server routes with no UI caller (on main):

Route Handler Note GET /api/adapters R/workflows.py:list_adapters CLI agentic list adapters covers the same data; no client.ts function GET /api/workflows/{name}/capabilities R/workflows.py:get_workflow_capabilities No caller anywhere in ui/src GET /api/model-finder/profile R/model_finder.py:profile UI uses /recommendations and /profile-override only GET /api/health/ready R/health.py:readiness_check Infra probe (Docker/K8s style); expected to be UI-less GET /api/runs/{run_id}/stream R/runs.py:stream_run_events UI streams via WebSocket, not SSE GET /api/eval/datasets/sample-list R/evaluation_routes.py:list_dataset_samples UI calls the path-based form (client.ts:401) instead GET /api/eval/datasets/sample-detail R/evaluation_routes.py:get_dataset_sample_detail UI calls the path-based form (client.ts:416) instead; legacy duplicate pair GET /metrics, /assets/*, SPA fallback — Not API; infra

All other /api routes (46 of 53) have a matching client.ts function (workflows list/dag/editor/validate/save, run, runs list/summary/detail/evaluation/evaluate, eval datasets/compare/samples, preview-dataset-inputs, agents, models probe/lmstudio, chat, personas/tools/observers, all settings/*, model-finder recommendations/override, health).

UI calls with no matching server route: none found. Every ${BASE}/... path in client.ts matches a decorated route above (query-string variants ?version= on model-pack endpoints match Query(..., ge=1) params).

WebSocket: UI connects to /ws/execution/{runId} in two places (api/websocket.ts, hooks/useNodeConfigUpdate.ts); pathPrefix is parameterised but only the execution prefix exists server-side (S/websocket.py:480). Dev proxy: ui/vite.config.ts proxies /api → VITE_API_PROXY_TARGET (default http://localhost:8010) and /ws with ws: true.

docs.title: 3.4 Auth and middleware chain
docs.text:
add_middleware prepends, so the last-added is outermost. Effective request order (outermost → innermost), from S/app.py:100-137 and create_app docstring:

# Layer Source Behavior Toggle 1 CORSMiddleware S/app.py:134 Origins from get_allowed_origins(); credentials on; methods GET/POST/PUT/DELETE/OPTIONS; headers Authorization, X-API-Key, Content-Type, Accept; exposes traceparent, tracestate, Server-Timing AGENTIC_CORS_ORIGINS 2 SlowAPIMiddleware S/middleware/rate_limit.py:configure_rate_limiting Global per-IP limit, default 60/minute; _public_exempt_key skips public paths; 429 JSON handler. Startup fails closed if slowapi is missing unless explicitly accepted (S/lifespan.py:89-118) AGENTIC_RATE_LIMIT_DEFAULT, AGENTIC_RATE_LIMIT_DISABLED (tests), AGENTIC_DISABLE_RATE_LIMITING 3 MetricsMiddleware S/middleware/metrics.py HTTP duration/count via OTEL metrics; no-op when disabled AGENTIC_METRICS 4 TraceparentMiddleware S/middleware/tracing.py Adds traceparent/tracestate/Server-Timing response headers from the active span AGENTIC_TRACING=1 5 SanitizationASGIMiddleware S/middleware/__init__.py Prompt-injection / secret redaction on request bodies using app.state.sanitization; fail-closed (HTTP 500) if init failed AGENTIC_SANITIZER_FAIL_OPEN=1 bypass 6 APIKeyMiddleware or OIDCAuthMiddleware S/auth.py:351, S/auth_oidc.py:213 Selected at app build time by settings.agentic_oidc_enabled. Token from Authorization: Bearer or X-API-Key; constant-time compare (secrets.compare_digest); 401 via build_auth_error_response; 429 via per-IP throttle on repeated failures AGENTIC_API_KEY; AGENTIC_OIDC_*

Also in the chain (not middleware): exception handler mapping NoProviderConfiguredError → HTTP 503 {detail} (S/app.py:146-155); per-route Depends(get_tenant_context) (tenant id from request header TENANT_HEADER, agentic_v2/core/tenant.py:64).

Auth details: - Public paths (S/auth.py:54-57,257): /metrics exactly; anything not starting with /api/; and /api/health*, /docs, /openapi.json, /redoc by prefix. Note /docs, /openapi.json and /redoc do not start with /api/, so they are already public via the non-/api rule. - API-key mode reads AGENTIC_API_KEY through get_secret() on every call (rotation without restart, S/auth.py:241-246). With no key and OIDC off, all routes are open (warning at S/lifespan.py:263). - OIDC mode (S/auth_oidc.py): validate_oidc_settings fails fast if issuer/audience/JWKS URL are missing (:81); OIDCAuthenticator verifies JWTs with PyJWT (_import_pyjwt, :375, lazy), JWKS cached; returns AuthenticatedActor {auth_type, subject, issuer, audience, tenant_id, organization_id}; 503 when the identity provider is unreachable (:298). AGENTIC_API_KEY remains a fallback credential (S/app.py:104-106 comment). - WebSocket auth is not covered by BaseHTTPMiddleware; _reject_websocket_connection re-implements origin + key + throttle + audit (S/websocket.py:520-600). It checks only the API key; OIDC bearer tokens are not validated on the WebSocket path (unverified: no OIDC reference in S/websocket.py). - Audit log: AuditLogger + AuditStore Protocol with NullAuditStore, FileAuditStore, RedisAuditStore (S/audit_log.py:61,77,90,144); built in lifespan from AUDIT_LOG_* settings.

Lifespan (S/lifespan.py:243-320): (1) warn if unauthenticated; (2) _validate_selected_adapter — AGENTIC_DEFAULT_ADAPTER (default langchain) must have its extras installed; (3) _enforce_rate_limiting_available; (4) _probe_llm_providers — error unless a provider key or AGENTIC_NO_LLM=1; (5) _install_smart_router — Redis-backed circuit-breaker state when REDIS_URL set, falling back to in-process on failure; (6) init ConnectionManager replay store (Redis/SQLite/memory); (7) build_audit_logger; yield; shutdown drains router Redis CAS tasks, closes replay store, shutdown_tracing().

SPA serving (S/spa.py): UI_DIST_DIR = agentic-workflows-v2/ui/dist; mounted only if UI_DIST_DIR.exists() (S/app.py:184).

docs.title: 3.6 Wire-format contracts (Pydantic → JSON Schema → TypeScript)
docs.text:
Pipeline (ADR-014, docs/adr/ADR-014-pydantic-wire-format.md):

  1. Pydantic models are the source of truth in agentic-workflows-v2/agentic_v2/contracts/ and server/models.py.
  2. python -m scripts.generate_ts_types (agentic-workflows-v2/scripts/generate_ts_types.py) dumps 8 schemas with TypeAdapter(...).json_schema() into agentic-workflows-v2/tests/schemas/ (indent=2, sort_keys=True).
  3. npm run generate:types (ui/scripts/generate-ts-types.mjs, json-schema-to-typescript) compiles each schema to ui/src/api/*.generated.ts, stripping property-level titles.
  4. CI job wire-format-drift (.github/workflows/ci.yml:347-408) regenerates both and fails on any diff.
Python contract Source file Committed schema (agentic-workflows-v2/tests/schemas/) Generated TS (ui/src/api/) TS consumer ExecutionEvent (discriminated union of 12 events) contracts/events.py events.schema.json events.generated.ts api/types.ts:267-269 StepResultRecord contracts/messages.py step_result.schema.json step_result.generated.ts api/types.ts:11 DAGResponse server/models.py dag_response.schema.json dag_response.generated.ts api/types.ts:23,46,49 WorkflowInputSchemaResponse server/models.py workflow_input_schema.schema.json workflow_input_schema.generated.ts api/types.ts:27 WorkflowEditorStep server/models.py workflow_editor_step.schema.json workflow_editor_step.generated.ts api/types.ts:33 RunsSummaryResponse server/models.py runs_summary.schema.json runs_summary.generated.ts api/types.ts:37,52 ChatRequest (model/tier overloads) contracts/chat.py chat_request.schema.json chat_request.generated.ts none ChatStreamEvent (token/route/media/done/error) contracts/chat.py chat_stream_event.schema.json chat_stream_event.generated.ts none

Verified unused: a search of ui/src, ui/tests and ui/e2e for each *.generated module name finds importers for the six rows above (all through api/types.ts) and none for chat_request.generated.ts or chat_stream_event.generated.ts. Chat types are hand-written in ui/src/api/types.ts (sections at lines ~783-835) and consumed by client.ts:4. They are therefore generated and drift-checked but not used; the Python↔TS chat contract is enforced only by regeneration, not by the compiler. Both files also appear in ui_inventory.unused_candidates.

Other schema artifacts and gates: - 23 per-class snapshot files in the same tests/schemas/ directory (WorkflowResult.json, StepResult.json, AgentMessage.json, ReviewReport.json, CodeReviewInput/Output.json, CodeGenerationOutput.json, TaskInput/Output.json, ChatMessage.json, ChatRequest.json, and the *Event.json files) are inputs to tests/test_schema_drift.py, which asserts the current model_json_schema() is a superset of the committed snapshot (additive changes pass, removals fail). They are not produced by generate_ts_types.py. - ui generate:types:check only diffs events.generated.ts (ui/package.json), narrower than the CI job, which diffs all generated files. - Hand-maintained wire types (not generated): ui/src/api/types.ts (settings, model packs, eval, datasets, chat), ui/src/api/hardware.ts; these mirror server/models.py, server/models_settings.py, server/evaluation.py by convention only. - Other contract surfaces: agentic_v2/contracts/ (TaskInput/Output, CodeReview*, WorkflowResult…), agentic_v2/artifact_contracts.py, agentic_v2/artifact_overlay.py.

docs.title: Env vars: .env.example vs code
docs.text:
Method: py_inventory.json modules[].env_vars (non-test modules, 62 distinct names) diffed against meta_inventory.json env_example_keys (99 names), then re-checked by substring search over non-test, non-docs source (.py/.yml/.toml/.ps1/.ts/.mjs). The AST extractor misses two read paths: (a) Settings pydantic fields (env name = upper-cased field name) and (b) get_secret("NAME") helper calls (e.g. AGENTIC_API_KEY, AGENTIC_CORS_ORIGINS). So a naive diff reports 63 "documented but unused" keys; the corrected breakdown is:

Documented in .env.example but never read in non-test source on main (6 keys, plus 1 stray):

Key Evidence Note AZURE_AI_SERVICES_ENDPOINT only .env.example hits Dead documentation AZURE_COGNITIVE_ENDPOINT only .env.example hits Dead documentation AZURE_OPENAI_DEPLOYMENT_0 only .env.example hits Indexed-suffix variant; code reads unsuffixed AZURE_OPENAI_DEPLOYMENT in tools/llm/ only LOCAL_MODEL_PATH only .env.example and prose docs (docs/architecture-runtime.md, docs/architecture-tools.md, docs/configuration.md) Doc-only VOYAGE_API_KEY only .env.example and docs/adr/ADR-035-rag-pipeline-architecture.md RAG embeddings planned/optional; no reader AGENTIC_MODEL_TIER_3, AGENTIC_MODEL_TIER_4 read only by agentic-workflows-v2/scripts/run_deep_research.py / .ps1; runtime reads TIER_1/2 (server/execution.py, langchain/models.py) Partially used provider parser artifact, not a key Ignore

All other .env.example keys are consumed, either by direct os.environ reads or via Settings fields (e.g. all AUDIT_LOG_*, REPLAY_*, REDIS_*, AGENTIC_OIDC_*, AGENTIC_APPROVAL_*, AGENTIC_REQUIRE_TOOL_APPROVAL, LOG_FORMAT, MAX_MCP_OUTPUT_TOKENS, AGENTIC_CHECKPOINTER_URL, AGENTIC_BLOCK_PRIVATE_IPS, AGENTIC_FILE_BASE_DIR, AGENTIC_MEMORY_PATH).

Read in code but absent from .env.example (used-but-undocumented):

Variable Read in Purpose AGENTIC_JUDGE_MODEL server/execution.py Model used by the LLM judge in post-run evaluation AGENTIC_MAX_COST_LANE models/model_registry.py Cost-lane ceiling for registry selection AGENTIC_UI_SETTINGS_PATH ui_settings.py Relocate .agentic_ui_settings.json (tests) HARDWARE_OVERRIDE_PATH server/routes/model_finder.py Hardware override file location OPENAI_API_BASE, OPENAI_ORG_ID langchain/model_builders.py, models/cloud_discovery.py, models/discovery_snapshot.py OpenAI-compatible base URL (note .env.example documents OPENAI_BASE_URL, a different name) / org LOCAL_AI_API_BASE_URL, LOCAL_OPENAI_BASE_URL langchain/model_builders.py, tools/llm/* Local OpenAI-compatible endpoints NOTEBOOKLM_MODEL, NOTEBOOKLM_GEMINI_MODEL langchain/model_builders.py NotebookLM model selection CLAUDE_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY_0, AZURE_FOUNDRY_ENDPOINT_2, OLLAMA_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, PROMPTS_GH_RATE_LIMIT_STRATEGY tools/llm/* Root tools/ package only (provider adapters / limit checks) PROMPTEVAL_ALLOW_REMOTE, PROMPTS_CACHE_ENABLED, GEN_MODEL, REF_MODEL, REV_MODEL, PYTHONIOENCODING tools/core/*, tools/llm/llm_client.py Root tools/ package only

Documentation-adjacent gaps among documented keys: .env.example documents OLLAMA_HOST, OLLAMA_API_KEY, LMSTUDIO_HOST, LM_API_TOKEN, DIGITALOCEAN_TOKEN, GITHUB_TOKEN; their readers go through provider tables and get_secret, not literal os.environ calls, so they were not re-verified one by one (unverified).

Operational toggles worth knowing (all documented): AGENTIC_API_KEY (auth on/off), AGENTIC_NO_LLM=1 (deterministic placeholder model, supported no-key baseline), AGENTIC_DEFAULT_ADAPTER, AGENTIC_RATE_LIMIT_*, AGENTIC_SANITIZER_FAIL_OPEN, AGENTIC_REGISTRY_STRICT, AGENTIC_STRICT_MODEL_VERIFY, AGENTIC_SHELL_ALLOWED_COMMANDS, AGENTIC_TRUSTED_MODEL_HASHES.

docs.text:
File Key facts ui/vite.config.ts Dev proxy /api -> VITE_API_PROXY_TARGET (default http://localhost:8010); /ws proxied with ws: true but the client bypasses it in dev (see 4.4). Defines compile-time __AGENTIC_ENABLE_WORKFLOW_BUILDER__: default "1" in development, otherwise requires env VITE_AGENTIC_ENABLE_WORKFLOW_BUILDER/AGENTIC_ENABLE_WORKFLOW_BUILDER. Injects import.meta.env.VITE_API_PROXY_TARGET only in dev. ui/vitest.config.ts jsdom, globals: true, setup src/__tests__/setup.ts, css: true, excludes e2e/**. Coverage v8, include src/**/*.{ts,tsx}, exclude tests/*.d.ts/main.tsx/vite-env.d.ts. ui/playwright.config.ts testDir: ./e2e, 90 s test timeout, workers: 4, retries: 0, fullyParallel: false, chromium only, trace/video/screenshot on failure. Spawns its own backend (uvicorn agentic_v2.server.app:app on 127.0.0.1:8010, AGENTIC_NO_LLM=1, venv python if present else python) and frontend (npm run dev on 127.0.0.1:5173), both reuseExistingServer: false. ui/nginx.conf Port 8080 SPA server: /healthz returns 200 ok; / uses try_files $uri $uri/ /index.html. No /api or /ws proxying — Dockerfile comment says ingress routes those to the backend. Dockerfile.ui (repo root) 3 stages: frontend-dev (node:26.11-bookworm-slim, npm ci, non-root node, npm run dev on 5173) -> frontend-build (npm run build) -> frontend (nginxinc/nginx-unprivileged:1.31-alpine, copies dist/, port 8080, wget healthcheck on /healthz). ui/components.json shadcn config; aliases @/components, @/lib/utils, @/components/ui; css src/styles/globals.css.

Two parsers read the same files; they do not accept the same keys.

Key Native loader workflows/loader.py (WorkflowLoader._parse_step, line 587) LangChain parser langchain/config.py (StepConfig, ~line 570) name, agent, description, depends_on, inputs, outputs yes yes input_contracts / output_contracts (kind code_artifact, ADR-052) yes (validated via artifact_contracts) yes when compiled to predicate using engine/expressions.ExpressionEvaluator stored as string, evaluated by langchain/expressions.py loop_until, loop_max (int or ${...} expr; expr stored as sentinel 0 + loop_max_expr) yes yes tools (list; omitted = tier default, [] = none) yes (metadata["tools"]) yes prompt_file yes (metadata["prompt_file"]) yes model_override / model alias parsed into metadata, but no code under engine/ reads it yes (graph_wiring.py:1002, agents.py:137) persona ignored yes (personas.py, graph_wiring.py:1011) observers, model_params ignored yes

Top-level keys common to both: name, description, version, capabilities{inputs,outputs}, inputs{type,description,required,default,enum}, outputs{from,optional}, evaluation{rubric_id,scoring_profile,criteria[]} (loader parses criteria with weight, critical_floor, formula_id, scale; weights may be derived), experimental, _templates (YAML anchors, ignored). A JSON Schema, agentic-workflows-v2/schemas/workflow.schema.json, is enforced in CI by scripts/validate-workflows.py (job validate-workflows).

Loader internals: WorkflowLoader.load(name) resolves <definitions_dir>/<name>.yaml|.yml, caches, builds a DAG (engine/dag.py), and calls resolve_agent (engine/agent_resolver.py) per step. resolve_agent infers tier from the prefix (tier0_..tier5_; unknown prefix defaults to tier 2), maps tier-0 names through TIER0_REGISTRY (exactly five: tier0_parser, tier0_process, tier0_counter, tier0_consensus, tier0_overlay), and builds an LLM step for tiers 1-5. Per-tier output caps: T1 4096, T2 8192, T3 16384, T4 16384, T5 32768 tokens (agent_resolver.py:96-100); tool loop bounded by MAX_TOOL_ROUNDS / MAX_TOOL_CALLS_PER_ROUND (engine/tool_execution.py).

plan_tribunal (20 steps; the five judge lanes are identical apart from persona, shown once):

flowchart TD
  brief["brieftier2_analyst"] --> R
  subgraph R["x5 parallel lanes: verification, concurrency, pragmatist, governance, adversary"]
    research["research_<judge>tier2_researchertools: file_read, search_files, web_search, http_get"]

  R --> ext["extend_slatetier2_analyst, tools: nonemerges ALT-ids"]

  end

  da["design_architecturetier3_architect"] --> api["generate_apitier2_coder"]
  da --> fe["generate_frontendtier2_coder"]

docs.title: 5.5 agentic-workflows-v2/evals/swe_ab/ (152 files)
docs.text:
What it is: a paired A/B experiment asking whether ARP's multi-step review-loop workflow fixes more SWE-bench defects than a single coder call (evals/swe_ab/README.md). Arm A = workflows/swe_fix_direct.yaml (parse then patch); Arm B = workflows/swe_fix_review_loop.yaml (parse, root cause, draft, regression review, revise, verify). Same model, temperature, seed and rubric (swe_fix_v1); paid credentials are stripped from the child environment. It drives ARP as a subprocess through bridge.py and imports only agentic_evalkit in run_ab.py (one-way boundary).

docs.title: 5.6.3 Defects found (reproduced against the clean tree)
docs.text:
1. HAS_LLM_EVALUATOR is always False. tools/agents/benchmarks/evaluation_pipeline.py:34-40 does from tools.agents.benchmarks.llm_evaluator import (…, print_evaluation_report, save_evaluation_report, summarize_batch_results) inside try/except ImportError. Those three functions now live only in evaluator_reporting.py (lines 64, 82, 207); llm_evaluator.py does not re-export them (its docstring just says they "live in evaluator_reporting"). The import fails silently, so the LLM-judge path of the benchmark pipeline is disabled. Confirmed by importing the module: HAS_LLM_EVALUATOR False. This is the root cause of the 10 deselected TestEvaluateTaskOutputLlm tests and explains why evaluator_reporting.py shows zero importers. Fix is a one-line import repoint plus re-enabling the tests.
  2. tools/core/cache.py cannot be imported (bare from response_cache import …), reproduced: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'response_cache'. tools/core/__init__.py advertises it. Together with response_cache.py and prompt_db.py this is a dead cluster (~650 LOC) with no live importer.

docs.title: 5.7.2 load/ (15 files)
docs.text:
Local, $0, no provider keys: Docker Compose stack (Redis, nginx round-robin lb on host port 8088, N backend replicas with AGENTIC_NO_LLM=1, native adapter, rate limiting off) plus grafana/k6.

File Purpose run_load.sh (140 ln) Orchestrates: build image, 1-replica run, scale to N (default 3), CAS-pressure scenario, direct Redis probe, readiness capture, teardown (KEEP_UP=1 keeps it) k6/scale_throughput.js POST /api/run acceptance + GET /api/workflows/{name}/dag under ramping VUs (default WORKFLOW=code_review) k6/redis_cas_consistency.js CAS-pressure HTTP scenario probe_redis_cas.py (172 ln) Direct concurrent exact-sum test through the production Redis compare-and-swap path compare_to_baseline.py (181 ln), baseline.json Regression gate: p99 and throughput vs baseline (p99_latency_ms 127.77, throughput_rps 282.68, derived from results/scale_3replica.json, 2026-06-17). Wired to nightly.yml lines 140-151 (3-replica blocking, 1-replica informational) results/*.json|txt (5) Committed captures; load-report-pages.yml renders docs/load-report.md from them via scripts/build_load_report.py docker-compose.load.yml, Dockerfile.load, nginx.load.conf Stack definition README.md States the key caveat: accepted background runs did not reach the model client and created no circuit-breaker keys, so the Redis probe, not the HTTP workload, is the counter-consistency evidence

Runnable status: not run here (needs Docker + Bash). CI never runs containers or k6; it only re-renders the report and compares committed numbers. The gate therefore compares a stale committed capture to a baseline derived from the same capture (it passes by construction until someone commits a new run).

docs.title: 6.6 Formal methods (proofs/)
docs.text:
• Toolchain: proofs/lean-toolchain = leanprover/lean4:v4.34.0. No Mathlib or Batteries (proofs/README.md).
  • Files: Main.lean, Scheduler.lean, Scheduler/Validate.lean, lakefile.toml, lake-manifest.json, README.md. About 116 top-level declarations (theorem, lemma, def, axiom, structure, inductive at column 0) across the three .lean files (grep count).
  • sorry: the two grep hits in Scheduler.lean (lines 2537-2538) sit in doc comments and are not proof terms (grep-based). lakefile.toml sets warningAsError, so real sorry fails the build.
  • Scope (README): the four ADR-060 scheduler guarantees are proved for a Lean model of dag_executor.py over every legal completion order. The Python code is not proved. Linkage is seeded replay on sampled schedules only.
  • Outstanding (README "Outstanding proof obligations", line 271 onward): DAG.get_execution_order (Kahn's algorithm) is not modelled; legality of FIRST_COMPLETED batches is checked per replayed trace (checkLegal), not proved for asyncio; timeout cleanup is covered by timeout_fails_closed.
  • lean-proofs.yml: timeout 20 min on PR, 60 otherwise (line 48). docs.title: 8.4 Docs checker coverage and mkdocs gaps
docs.text:
Checkers wired into just docs and CI. The justfile docs recipe runs three scripts. In .github/workflows/ci.yml, job check-doc-drift (line 529) runs scripts/check-doc-drift.py and agentic-workflows-v2/scripts/check_docs_refs.py, and job doc-stats-drift (line 560) runs generate_doc_stats.py --check. The mkdocs build runs separately in .github/workflows/docs.yml.

Script Scope Result on c3b2d328 agentic-workflows-v2/scripts/check_docs_refs.py Fixed TARGET_FILES (15 entries, relative to agentic-workflows-v2/) plus WORKSPACE_TARGET_FILES (4 entries, relative to ARP root). Note: the script lives in agentic-workflows-v2/scripts/, not root scripts/. OK: no broken local paths, no retired RAG references scripts/check-doc-drift.py docs/ARCHITECTURE.md vs agentic_v2/core/protocols.py; ADR **Status:** body lines vs ADR-INDEX.md OK: 8 protocols documented; 46 explicit ADR statuses match the index; ADR-042 pinned Accepted; no claimed number reclaimed scripts/generate_doc_stats.py --check Generated doc statistics Not run (unverified)

Files NOT covered by check_docs_refs.py (link and path checks):

  • Of agentic-workflows-v2/docs/, only README, ARCHITECTURE, WORKFLOWS, DEVELOPMENT, REPO_MAP, DOCS_BEST_PRACTICES, API_REFERENCE and MODEL_LAYER are listed. Not covered: NODE_CONFIG_OVERLAY.md, tutorials/*, adr/*.
  • docs/reports/ACTIVE_VS_LEGACY_TOOLING_MAP.md is in TARGET_FILES but agentic-workflows-v2/docs/reports/ does not exist. The .exists() guard skips it silently, so the entry is dead.
  • Root docs/** (128 markdown files in total, of which most are unscanned): only docs/KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md and docs/ROADMAP.md are scanned, via the workspace list.
  • Root README.md, docs/api-contracts-runtime.md, docs/configuration.md, docs/deployment-guide.md, docs/tools/*, docs/evaluation/*, docs/ui/*, and all ADRs are not scanned. That is why the two broken links in 8.3 survived.
  • The retired-RAG pattern check runs over the same lists. No checker matches the stale GitHub Models or "fourteen jobs" claims in 8.1.
  • check-doc-drift.py ADR check uses ^\*\*Status:\*\* only. ADRs 007-012 and 054 use a table | **Status** | and are not governed (see 8.5).

  • Nav entries: 60. Every nav target exists under docs/. No nav entry points at a missing file.
  • Changelog nav entry resolves to docs/CHANGELOG.md, the stale stub, not the root changelog.

docs.title: What this repository is
docs.text:
A tier-routed, multi-agent LLM workflow runtime. YAML workflows compile to a DAG. The DAG runs either on a native Kahn's-algorithm asyncio executor or on a LangGraph adapter (the default for named workflows). Each step names a capability tier, never a model. SmartModelRouter resolves the tier to a provider through three-state circuit breakers and bulkheads. A FastAPI server streams execution over WebSocket and SSE to a React 19 "ARP Console". A fail-closed governance layer (human-in-the-loop tool approval and an SSRF egress guard) sits in front of tool dispatch. Around the runtime are:

  • an offline evaluation harness (agentic-v2-eval, being migrated to the external agentic-evalkit);
  • a shared tools/ package (model probes, benchmarks);
  • Lean 4 proofs of the scheduler.

docs.title: Top findings (cross-section)
docs.text:
1. Generated chat contract is checked by CI but never used. ui/src/api/chat_request.generated.ts and chat_stream_event.generated.ts pass the wire-format-drift gate, but nothing imports them. The UI uses hand-written copies in ui/src/api/types.ts. A backend schema change would therefore stay green while the UI types silently drift (§3.5, §4.6).
  2. A silent broken import disables the benchmark LLM-judge. tools/agents/benchmarks/evaluation_pipeline.py:34-40 imports reporting helpers from llm_evaluator, but they moved to evaluator_reporting.py. A try/except ImportError swallows the failure, so HAS_LLM_EVALUATOR is always False. This is the real cause of the 10 deselected TestEvaluateTaskOutputLlm tests (§5.6).
  3. There is no route to submit HITL approval decisions. ApprovalRequiredEvent and ApprovalDecisionEvent exist, but no HTTP or WebSocket handler accepts a decision. The WebSocket also ignores every client message, including the node_config_update frames the UI sends (§3.1, §4.6).
  4. The two engines aren't interchangeable. model_override, persona, observers and model_params are honoured only by the LangChain adapter. There are two parallel YAML parsers (workflows/loader.py and langchain/config.py) and two WorkflowRunners. docs/WORKFLOW_AUTHORING.md mentions none of this (§2, §5.1).
  5. Dead code is small and well-bounded. Deletion candidates:
  6. Python: engine/patterns.py (empty stub), models/llm.py (legacy adapter scheduled for deletion by ADR-042), tools/core/{cache,response_cache,prompt_db}.py (cache.py doesn't even import), tools/llm/list_gemini.py.
  7. UI: nine unused shadcn primitives (making react-resizable-panels a dead dependency), BBox, BSpark, useNodeConfigUpdate, the NodeConfigOverlay prototype, PrototypeLabPage, and the test-only SettingsPage (§2, §4.6, §5.6).
  8. Config and docs have drifted from the code:
  9. .env.example documents 5 keys nothing reads and omits about 6 keys the code reads (§3.8).
  10. The workspace CLAUDE.md §7 and ADR-042 quote the EK and EVK pins as 0.3.x, but main pins executionkit>=0.4.0,<0.5.0 and agentic-evalkit>=0.4.1,<0.5.0 (§1.3).
  11. portfolio-context.md says 17 CI jobs; there are 20 (§6.1).
  12. docs/deployment-guide.md still lists the deleted manifest-temperature-check.yml (§6.9).
  13. Toolchain versions disagree. .nvmrc says Node 20, CI uses 22, Dockerfile.ui uses 26.11. Pre-commit ruff is 0.16.5, but the dev group requires ≥0.16.10. nginx.conf proxies neither /api nor /ws (§4.1, §6.3).
  14. Docs still advertise retired things.
  15. docs/configuration.md:63 and docs/getting-started/installation.md:168 still list GitHub Models, which was retired on 2026-07-30 (ADR-016).
  16. docs/deployment-guide.md:13 says CI has "fourteen jobs"; it has 20.
  17. ADR-008 says Proposed in its file but Accepted in ADR-INDEX.md.
  18. check_docs_refs.py scans only 19 of about 205 markdown files, so most of docs/** is never link-checked (§8).
  19. About 1.2 GB of local-only clutter is on disk.
  20. Safe to delete: caches and build outputs, for example .mypy_cache/ (620 MB), .cache/ (134 MB), proofs/.lake/ (116 MB) and site/.
  21. Also deletable: the __pycache__-only orphan packages agentic_v2/rag/ and agentic_v2/memoryctl/, and agentic-workflows-v2/New folder (2)/.
  22. Keep: runs/, the replay DBs and .env, which hold user data (§7).

All counts come from scripts committed alongside this document. Re-run them against a fresh origin/main worktree:

git worktree add --detach ../arp-main-inventory origin/main
ARP_INVENTORY_REPO=../arp-main-inventory .venv/Scripts/python.exe scripts/inventory/run_all.py
.venv/Scripts/python.exe scripts/inventory/assemble.py
uv run --no-project --with markdown python scripts/inventory/render_html.py
Script Extracts scripts/inventory/fs_inventory.py Per-directory tracked and untracked counts, sizes, last-commit age, large files, orphan __pycache__-only packages scripts/inventory/py_inventory.py AST per module: LOC, classes (Pydantic, Protocol, Enum, …), functions, FastAPI routes, import graph (absolute, relative and lazy), env-var reads, TODO markers, test references, orphan candidates scripts/inventory/ui_inventory.py TS/TSX import graph, exports, /api calls, routes, unused and test-only files, external package usage scripts/inventory/meta_inventory.py Workflow YAML steps, CI jobs, ADR statuses, doc staleness and broken links, dependency manifests, git branches, worktrees and PRs scripts/inventory/assemble.py / render_html.py Concatenate the section files and render the Superdesign-styled HTML report

The section narratives (§1–§9) were written by parallel research agents working from that data and the code, each told to verify its claims. Read them with these limitations in mind:

  • Orphan detection is a candidate list, not a verdict. Registry and string-based wiring evades static import graphs. Every "unused" item in §2, §4 and §5 was re-checked with grep.
  • The env-var extractor misses some reads. It doesn't catch reads through pydantic Settings fields or get_secret(); §3.8 corrects for this by hand.
  • File age isn't a reliable staleness signal for the UI. A broad restyle sweep touched most files within the last week.
  • Items marked "(unverified)" were not confirmed.

docs.title: 1.5 Theories, concepts and patterns implemented
docs.text:
# Concept What it is Where implemented ADR 1 Kahn's topological DAG execution Track per-step in-degree at runtime; launch every zero-in-degree step concurrently (wavefront); unlock dependents on completion engine/dag.py (DAG, topological order, validate), engine/dag_executor.py (_schedule_ready_steps, _unlock_downstream, _scheduling_loop) ADR-001/002/003, ADR-019 2 Cascade skip / honest status Failed step's transitive dependents are SKIPPED with a reason; run is SUCCESS only if nothing failed or was dropped engine/dag_executor.py (_cascade_skip, _mark_skipped), agents/orchestrator.py ADR-060 3 Formal verification of the scheduler Lean 4 model of DAGExecutor proves safety, no duplicates / bounded parallelism, completeness, honest status over every legal completion order; a replay test ties model to code on sampled schedules (not a proof of the Python) proofs/Scheduler.lean, proofs/Scheduler/, proofs/Main.lean, tests/engine/test_dag_executor_lean_replay.py (named in proofs/README.md, not opened) ADR-060 4 Engine swap behind a Protocol seam Structural typing.Protocol contracts + thread-safe registry core/protocols.py, adapters/registry.py ADR-001, ADR-020; ADR-031 (single-engine, not adopted) 5 Join-once semantics for superstep engines Each step runs once after all deps even on LangGraph langchain/graph_wiring.py (wire_graph_edges, wire_dependency_edges, build_loop_exit_map, add_loop_edge) ADR-062 6 Capability-tier routing Steps request tier 0 (deterministic) to 5 (premium cloud); router resolves via per-tier fallback chains from a curated registry models/router.py (ModelTier, register_chain, DEFAULT_CHAINS), models/smart_router.py, models/model_registry.py ADR-040, ADR-059, ADR-051 7 Three-state circuit breaker CLOSED / OPEN / HALF_OPEN per provider with single-probe lock; CircuitResolvedError when a prior probe already resolved the circuit models/smart_router.py (execute_with_bulkhead, ~lines 814-1016), models/model_stats.py ADR-001/002/003 (ADR-002A) 8 Bulkheads Per-provider semaphores prevent cascade failure models/smart_router.py:190,256 ADR-002A 9 Shared breaker state via compare-and-swap Lua-script atomic CAS in Redis keeps counters exact under concurrent writers; evidence is a k6 run plus an exact-sum worker test models/redis_state.py, docs/flagship.md, load/ no dedicated ADR found (unverified) 10 Health, cooldown, rate-limit awareness Honour retry guidance, cooldowns, HTTP-status error classification models/smart_router.py (CooldownConfig), models/rate_limit_tracker.py, models/retry_utils.py none 11 Majority-vote consensus / self-consistency Same prompt N times, deterministic tier-0 vote, min_agreement threshold engine/consensus.py (majority_vote, self_consistency), engine/agent_resolver.py:309 (tier0_consensus), workflows/definitions/consensus_review.yaml ADR-023 (EK relationship) 12 Plan tribunal (multi-judge panel) Five persona judges, two-stage deterministic vote, dissent recorded, split ruling never presented as a decision workflows/definitions/plan_tribunal.yaml none found 13 Bounded iterative review loop loop_until + loop_max review-rework cycles; verification gate/loop for post-step checks workflows/definitions/iterative_review.yaml, engine/step.py, engine/verification.py (VerificationGate, VerificationLoop) ADR-019 for timeout; loop-specific ADR unverified 14 Adaptive decomposition / orchestrator Orchestrator plans subtasks, validates plan as a DAG, runs with max_parallel, fallback chains, escalation agents/orchestrator.py, orchestrator_planning.py, orchestrator_models.py, governance/escalation.py ADR-029, ADR-025, ADR-060 15 LLM-as-judge rubric scoring Rubric criteria scored by a judge model; multidimensional profiles scoring/judge.py (LLMJudge, JudgeResponseProvider), scoring/rubrics/, scoring/multidimensional_scoring.py, prompts/judges/, agentic-v2-eval/src/ ADR-009, ADR-010, ADR-032, ADR-044 16 Discriminated-union wire format + codegen Pydantic Field(discriminator="type") unions -> JSON Schema -> generated TS; CI drift gate contracts/events.py:181, contracts/chat.py:84,262, ui/scripts/generate-ts-types.mjs, tests/schemas/ ADR-014, ADR-052 17 Fail-closed governance (HITL) No ApprovalProvider registered => tool call denied; gate runs before validation at both dispatch points; timeouts governance/approval.py (AutoDenyProvider, PolicyApprovalProvider, tool_requires_approval), engine/tool_execution.py ADR-041, ADR-045, ADR-047 18 SSRF egress guard Block private/loopback/metadata addresses; resolve-and-pin to limit DNS rebinding; residual risk documented security/url_guard.py (validate_url, validate_url_pinned, check_resolved_address), tools/builtin/http_ops.py ADR-030; KNOWN_LIMITATIONS 4.4 19 AST expression sandbox when / loop_until parsed via ast.parse(mode="eval") and a whitelist interpreter; no eval() engine/expressions.py:101-132, langchain/expressions.py ADR-024 20 Content sanitization and secret masking Detector chain (injection, PII, secrets, unicode); entropy-based masking; JSON-safe masks that do not break parsing middleware/detectors/, middleware/policy.py, middleware/response_sanitizer.py, contracts/sanitization.py ADR-046, ADR-061 21 AuthN/AuthZ and tenancy API key + JWT/OIDC, per-IP auth throttle, client-supplied X-Tenant-ID path scoping (spoofable by default) server/auth.py, server/auth_oidc.py, core/tenant.py, server/middleware/rate_limit.py ADR-018, ADR-021, ADR-022; KNOWN_LIMITATIONS 4.1, 4.2, 4.5 22 Process-wide token budget Global cap on tokens consumed grep hits in engine/tool_execution.py, contracts/verification.py, engine/ek_step_delegation.py (exact owner unverified) ADR-048 23 OpenTelemetry tracing Spans per run/step (tracer from integrations/otel.py), server tracing middleware, browser OTel, Prometheus metrics engine/dag_executor.py:27,610, integrations/otel.py, server/middleware/tracing.py, ui/src/telemetry/, otel/ none 24 Deterministic no-LLM mode AGENTIC_NO_LLM=1 swaps model clients for placeholders; tier0_* agents run deterministic handlers; supported credential-free baseline langchain/model_builders.py:972 (PlaceholderChatModel), models/backends.py:37, models/client.py (ERR_NO_LLM_BACKEND), settings.py, docs/NO_LLM_MODE.md, workflows/definitions/test_deterministic.yaml none 25 Tool descriptions as selection mechanism / forced tool choice Tool selection steered by description quality and tool_choice forcing tools/base.py, tools/registry.py ADR-027, ADR-028 26 Step-output parsing unification One parser for LLM output so both engines see the same data engine/llm_output_parsing.py (1015 lines) ADR unverified 27 Typed step artifacts / path-first IO Steps exchange typed artifact contracts; path-first IO is only proposed workflows/artifact_extractor.py ADR-052 (Accepted), ADR-034 (Proposed) 28 Model discovery and pricing annotation Live discovery of local/cloud models, curated registry, price labels, weight-integrity checks models/*_discovery.py, models/price_annotation.py, models/weight_integrity.py ADR-037, ADR-038, ADR-039, ADR-040 29 Prompt versioning registry Versioned prompts prompts/registry.py ADR-056 30 Guarded delegation to ExecutionKit Optional step delegation to an external pattern library engine/ek_step_delegation.py ADR-023 31 Evidence-labelled claims Claims graded SOURCE/TEST/RUNTIME/LIVE-VERIFIED, INFERRED, UNVERIFIED AI_EVIDENCE_STANDARD.md, docs/PROOF_LEDGER.md none

Removed or superseded concepts (do not expect code): RAG pipeline (ADR-035 Superseded; ADR-057 removed the package); GitHub Models as default E2E LLM (ADR-016 Superseded; service retired upstream 2026-07-30 per docs/architecture-runtime.md:595); single-engine native DAG (ADR-031 Superseded, never adopted). Numbering gaps in docs/adr/ (no files for 004-006, 013, 049, 053) are declared intentional in docs/adr/ADR-INDEX.md (the declared list itself was not re-read here).

docs.title: 1.6 Design principles and constraints
docs.text: Principle / constraint Statement Source Steps name tiers, not models Workflow structure separate from model selection; router resolves env pins, saved UI settings, availability, health, fallbacks PRODUCT.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md Fail closed and show why Approval-required tools denied without a provider PRODUCT.md, README.md Work credential-free AGENTIC_NO_LLM=1 is the supported no-key baseline; never imply a provider is required PRODUCT.md, .claude/rules/ci.md Legible run state before pretty Operator must see what ran, what failed, why PRODUCT.md Do not overclaim maturity Link limitations; no testimonials or hosted-service claims PRODUCT.md, docs/KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md Evidence over assertion Cite active call path; mock/no-LLM tests are not live-provider evidence; missing evidence is UNVERIFIED not a defect; date live/perf claims; prefer behaviour over test counts AI_EVIDENCE_STANDARD.md (10 rules) Smallest coherent change, reuse infra One concern per PR; reuse SmartModelRouter, ExecutionContext, ConversationMemory, MCP client stack, error-classification helpers CLAUDE.md Secrets only via env / .env.example Never read/edit/commit .env CLAUDE.md Package boundaries intact Runtime, eval, tools, UI each own their area; no path hacks into tools/ CONTRIBUTING.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md Generated files preserved unless contract changed Contract change => regenerate schemas + TS and commit CONTRIBUTING.md, .claude/rules/ci.md Automated-evidence gates (solo, AI-assisted) AI-generated code is untrusted input; ruff + mypy + tests + docs + pre-commit green .claude/rules/ci.md Coverage gate 80% over agentic_v2 configured subset, precision = 2; UI vitest floors (branches >=56 ratchet, others >=60) .claude/rules/ci.md, ui/vitest.config.ts Suppression ratchet A new ruff ignore, per-file-ignore, or mypy ignore_errors fails CI .claude/rules/portfolio-context.md (scripts/check_suppression_ratchet.py) Style Black 88, Ruff, typed public interfaces; new patterns CONTRIBUTING.md "Write an ADR" ADRs immutable Do not rewrite accepted ADRs; supersede and update ADR-INDEX.md docs/ARCHITECTURE.md Conventional commits type(scope): subject; scope = subsystem .claude/rules/ci.md, CONTRIBUTING.md Changelog User-visible changes under Unreleased CONTRIBUTING.md UI design system "Evidence Ledger" Warm paper neutrals, one vermilion accent (#ef5a36), hairline borders over shadows, radii 2/4/8px, Georgia display + Geist body + mono for ids; docs.title: Known limitations that bound the architecture (docs/KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md)
docs.text: Ref Limitation 1.1 Wire format generated for 8 shapes only; others manually mirrored 1.2 80% coverage gate scopes out optional provider/plugin modules ([tool.coverage.run] omit) 2.1 LangChain adapter needs a separate extras install 3.1 Blocking CI does not prove live provider behaviour 4.1, 4.2 Rate limiting and auth throttle are in-process only (multi-replica caveat) 4.3 Human approval gates are programmatic only; no UI pause/resume yet 4.4 SSRF guard cannot fully close DNS rebinding without network-layer egress control 4.5 X-Tenant-ID is client-supplied and spoofable by default 4.12-4.14 Model inventory command fails from repo root; onnx: IDs unusable for exact-model chat; strict weight verification not wired into every loader 4.15 Eleven tools/tests cases assert a removed API; ci.yml now lists a tools-tests job, so whether this is still current is unverified

docs.title: 2. Runtime backend — components & data structures (agentic_v2)
docs.text: Scope: agentic-workflows-v2/agentic_v2/ at origin/main c3b2d328 (clean worktree ../arp-main-inventory). 244 Python modules, 61,892 LOC (inventory counts, __init__ files included). Only console script: [project.scripts] agentic = "agentic_v2.cli:main" (agentic-workflows-v2/pyproject.toml:130-131). Section 3 covers the HTTP/WS API; section 5 covers the YAML workflow definitions; this section covers the Python components behind them.

docs.title: 2.0 How to read the tables
docs.text:
• LOC — physical lines from docs/inventory/data/py_inventory.json.
  • used by — distinct in-package modules importing the module, recomputed by AST with relative imports resolved. The raw imported_by field misses from .x import y, which is why contracts.schemas and governance.escalation looked orphaned there. A (pkg) row counts importers of the package itself.
  • tests — number of test files (agentic-workflows-v2/tests/**, repo-root tests/**) that contain the module path or one of its public class/function names. A name-match heuristic: 0 is reliable (no reference anywhere); a positive count is an upper bound on real coverage.
  • status — Active = imported by another runtime module; Test-only = imported by no runtime module but referenced by tests; Orphan? = neither (only models.llm after verification; see 2.24). Flags >800 LOC, TODO, no tests are appended. Active (pkg) marks __init__ re-export hubs.
  • Purpose is the module docstring first line; where empty, the first public class/function docstring; a few docstring-less modules got a hand-written purpose.

docs.title: 2.0.1 Layering at a glance
docs.text: layer subpackages notes Contracts and core contracts, core, artifact_contracts, settings, ui_settings Pydantic wire types, protocols, error hierarchy, tenant scoping, env-driven settings; imported by nearly everything. Execution engine engine, adapters, workflows, langchain Native DAG executor (engine/dag_executor.py) vs LangGraph path (langchain/), selected through adapters/registry.py. Model plane models, prompts, config/defaults Tier routing, backends, discovery, circuit breakers, curated registry (config/defaults/model_registry.yaml). Agents and tools agents, tools, integrations (MCP) Agent classes, built-in tools, MCP client stack. Safety governance, middleware, security Approval gate, escalation sink, prompt/response sanitization chain, SSRF URL guard. Scoring scoring, evaluation Rubric/judge scoring, hard gates, EvalKit bridge. Surfaces server, cli, devex FastAPI app (summary only here), Typer CLI, dev tooling.

docs.text: Counts across agentic_v2/ (inventory classes[].kinds): 132 Pydantic models, 31 Enums, 15 Protocols, 10 ABCs, 6 exception classes, 1 TypedDict (langchain/state.py), 1 pydantic-settings class (settings.py); a further 119 @dataclass classes were found by AST scan (the inventory's kinds field does not tag dataclasses). The table below lists the ones that matter; WIRE marks the eight wire-format contract models.

docs.title: 2.23.1 The 8 wire-format contract models (Python to JSON Schema to TypeScript)
docs.text:
Pipeline: Pydantic model, then agentic-workflows-v2/scripts/generate_ts_types.py writes the aggregate JSON Schema into agentic-workflows-v2/tests/schemas/, then npm run generate:types (from ui/) emits the *.generated.ts mirror. CI job wire-format-drift fails on any mismatch (.claude/rules/ci.md, ADR-014). The generated headers say "AUTO-GENERATED — DO NOT EDIT BY HAND".

# Pydantic model defined in JSON Schema (agentic-workflows-v2/tests/schemas/) TS mirror (agentic-workflows-v2/ui/src/api/) TS LOC 1 ExecutionEvent (discriminated union) agentic_v2/contracts/events.py events.schema.json events.generated.ts 182 2 StepResultRecord agentic_v2/contracts/messages.py step_result.schema.json step_result.generated.ts 70 3 DAGResponse agentic_v2/server/models.py dag_response.schema.json dag_response.generated.ts 93 4 WorkflowInputSchemaResponse agentic_v2/server/models.py workflow_input_schema.schema.json workflow_input_schema.generated.ts 96 5 WorkflowEditorStep agentic_v2/server/models.py workflow_editor_step.schema.json workflow_editor_step.generated.ts 66 6 RunsSummaryResponse agentic_v2/server/models.py runs_summary.schema.json runs_summary.generated.ts 30 7 ChatRequest (RootModel union) agentic_v2/contracts/chat.py chat_request.schema.json chat_request.generated.ts 186 8 ChatStreamEvent (discriminated union) agentic_v2/contracts/chat.py chat_stream_event.schema.json chat_stream_event.generated.ts 57

Source of the mapping: module docstring and constants at agentic-workflows-v2/scripts/generate_ts_types.py:9-53. agentic-workflows-v2/ui/src/api/ also holds hand-written client.ts, types.ts, websocket.ts, hardware.ts (not generated).

Separate from the eight: agentic-workflows-v2/tests/schemas/ holds 24 further per-model snapshots (AgentMessage.json, ChatDoneEvent.json, CodeReviewOutput.json, ReviewReport.json, StepResult.json, TaskInput.json, WorkflowResult.json, ...; 32 files total including the 8 aggregates), written by agentic-workflows-v2/scripts/generate_schemas.py and checked by agentic-workflows-v2/tests/test_schema_drift.py. These have no TS mirror (inferred from absence of matching *.generated.ts).

docs.title: 3.1 HTTP API surface
docs.text:
The app factory is create_app() in S/app.py. Every router in R/ is mounted with prefix="/api" (S/app.py:158-167) except the WebSocket router (/ws/..., no prefix, S/app.py:168), the optional Prometheus mount at /metrics, and the SPA catch-all. That gives 55 decorated route handlers (py_inventory.json): 53 under /api, 1 WebSocket, 1 SPA fallback.

Auth column legend: key = requires AGENTIC_API_KEY bearer/X-API-Key when that env var is set (otherwise the server is open and S/lifespan.py:263-266 logs a warning); public = exempt in is_public_path (S/auth.py:54-57, 257-269); tenant = also resolves Depends(get_tenant_context) (agentic_v2/core/tenant.py:64, header-based tenant id).

Method Path Handler Purpose Auth WEBSOCKET /ws/execution/{run_id} S/websocket.py:websocket_endpoint (line 480) Live execution stream (see 3.2) in-handler: origin check + API key; HTTP middleware skips non-/api/ paths GET /metrics mount of get_metrics_app() (S/app.py:170-176, agentic_v2/integrations/metrics.py) Prometheus scrape; mounted only when AGENTIC_METRICS=1 and opentelemetry-exporter-prometheus is installed public (_PUBLIC_EXACT_PATHS, S/auth.py:57) GET /assets/* StaticFiles mount (S/spa.py:_mount_spa) Built UI assets from agentic-workflows-v2/ui/dist/assets public (non-/api) GET /{path:path} S/spa.py:spa_fallback Serves real dist/ files (realpath/commonpath traversal guard) else index.html; only mounted if ui/dist exists public

Observations: - GET /{path:path} is registered after API routers, but any unmatched GET under /api/... returns index.html (HTTP 200) instead of a JSON 404 when the UI is built (S/spa.py:49-66). Unverified at runtime; derived from the code. - No HTTP route exists for submitting an approval decision. ApprovalRequiredEvent/ApprovalDecisionEvent are defined (agentic_v2/contracts/events.py:137,153) but a grep of S/websocket.py and R/*.py for "approv" returns nothing, so the HITL decision channel is in-process only (agentic_v2/governance/approval.py).

docs.title: 3.2 Streaming: SSE and WebSocket
docs.text:
Channel Endpoint Direction Event types (type field) Evidence WebSocket /ws/execution/{run_id} server → client; client frames are read and ignored (await websocket.receive_text() loop) First (only if AGENTIC_TRACING): trace_context {traceparent, tracestate?}; then replayed buffer; then live ExecutionEvent union: workflow_start, step_start, step_end, token_delta, step_complete, step_error, workflow_end, error, evaluation_start, evaluation_complete, approval_required, approval_decision S/websocket.py:480-516, 645-655; agentic_v2/contracts/events.py:16-156 SSE GET /api/runs/{run_id}/stream server → client same run events fanned out from ConnectionManager._sse_listeners, plus keepalive S/websocket.py:89-103, 417; R/runs.py:628-659 SSE POST /api/chat server → client (data: <json>\n\n) token, route, media (png/jpeg/webp/gif), done, error agentic_v2/contracts/chat.py:209-249; R/chat.py:269-309

WebSocket details: - Terminal events that clear the replay buffer: workflow_end, error (S/websocket.py:110, 324). - Replay store (late joiners): ReplayStore Protocol with InMemoryReplayStore, RedisReplayStore, SqliteReplayStore (S/replay_store.py:124,170,229,442), chosen by REPLAY_STORE_BACKEND. - Close codes: 1008 for disallowed origin, query-string ?token= (deprecated, rejected), missing/invalid key, or per-IP lockout (S/websocket.py:520-600). - Per-IP auth throttle shared with HTTP (AuthThrottle, S/auth.py:79-204): defaults 5 failures / 60 s window / 300 s lockout via AGENTIC_AUTH_LOCKOUT_*. - Origin policy (S/auth.py:294-320): no Origin header allowed; same-host allowed; any localhost/127.0.0.1 port allowed; otherwise AGENTIC_CORS_ORIGINS (or _DEFAULT_CORS_ORIGINS). - Dead client message: UI useNodeConfigUpdate sends {type:"node_config_update", step_name, config} over the same socket (ui/src/hooks/useNodeConfigUpdate.ts:77-81), but the server loop discards all inbound text, so that feature has no server effect. The hook is also in ui_inventory.unused_candidates.

docs.title: 3.3 API ↔ UI cross-check
docs.text:
UI HTTP client is agentic-workflows-v2/ui/src/api/client.ts (BASE = "/api", all calls via fetchJSON, plus a hand-rolled SSE reader in sendChat, client.ts:498). WebSocket client is ui/src/api/websocket.ts:49 (/ws/${pathPrefix}/${runId}, default prefix execution). ui_inventory.json api_calls captured only 2 literal paths (/api/health, /api/), so the matrix below was built by reading client.ts directly.

Server routes with no UI caller (on main):

Route Handler Note GET /api/adapters R/workflows.py:list_adapters CLI agentic list adapters covers the same data; no client.ts function GET /api/workflows/{name}/capabilities R/workflows.py:get_workflow_capabilities No caller anywhere in ui/src GET /api/model-finder/profile R/model_finder.py:profile UI uses /recommendations and /profile-override only GET /api/health/ready R/health.py:readiness_check Infra probe (Docker/K8s style); expected to be UI-less GET /api/runs/{run_id}/stream R/runs.py:stream_run_events UI streams via WebSocket, not SSE GET /api/eval/datasets/sample-list R/evaluation_routes.py:list_dataset_samples UI calls the path-based form (client.ts:401) instead GET /api/eval/datasets/sample-detail R/evaluation_routes.py:get_dataset_sample_detail UI calls the path-based form (client.ts:416) instead; legacy duplicate pair GET /metrics, /assets/*, SPA fallback — Not API; infra

All other /api routes (46 of 53) have a matching client.ts function (workflows list/dag/editor/validate/save, run, runs list/summary/detail/evaluation/evaluate, eval datasets/compare/samples, preview-dataset-inputs, agents, models probe/lmstudio, chat, personas/tools/observers, all settings/*, model-finder recommendations/override, health).

UI calls with no matching server route: none found. Every ${BASE}/... path in client.ts matches a decorated route above (query-string variants ?version= on model-pack endpoints match Query(..., ge=1) params).

WebSocket: UI connects to /ws/execution/{runId} in two places (api/websocket.ts, hooks/useNodeConfigUpdate.ts); pathPrefix is parameterised but only the execution prefix exists server-side (S/websocket.py:480). Dev proxy: ui/vite.config.ts proxies /api → VITE_API_PROXY_TARGET (default http://localhost:8010) and /ws with ws: true.

docs.title: 3.4 Auth and middleware chain
docs.text:
add_middleware prepends, so the last-added is outermost. Effective request order (outermost → innermost), from S/app.py:100-137 and create_app docstring:

# Layer Source Behavior Toggle 1 CORSMiddleware S/app.py:134 Origins from get_allowed_origins(); credentials on; methods GET/POST/PUT/DELETE/OPTIONS; headers Authorization, X-API-Key, Content-Type, Accept; exposes traceparent, tracestate, Server-Timing AGENTIC_CORS_ORIGINS 2 SlowAPIMiddleware S/middleware/rate_limit.py:configure_rate_limiting Global per-IP limit, default 60/minute; _public_exempt_key skips public paths; 429 JSON handler. Startup fails closed if slowapi is missing unless explicitly accepted (S/lifespan.py:89-118) AGENTIC_RATE_LIMIT_DEFAULT, AGENTIC_RATE_LIMIT_DISABLED (tests), AGENTIC_DISABLE_RATE_LIMITING 3 MetricsMiddleware S/middleware/metrics.py HTTP duration/count via OTEL metrics; no-op when disabled AGENTIC_METRICS 4 TraceparentMiddleware S/middleware/tracing.py Adds traceparent/tracestate/Server-Timing response headers from the active span AGENTIC_TRACING=1 5 SanitizationASGIMiddleware S/middleware/__init__.py Prompt-injection / secret redaction on request bodies using app.state.sanitization; fail-closed (HTTP 500) if init failed AGENTIC_SANITIZER_FAIL_OPEN=1 bypass 6 APIKeyMiddleware or OIDCAuthMiddleware S/auth.py:351, S/auth_oidc.py:213 Selected at app build time by settings.agentic_oidc_enabled. Token from Authorization: Bearer or X-API-Key; constant-time compare (secrets.compare_digest); 401 via build_auth_error_response; 429 via per-IP throttle on repeated failures AGENTIC_API_KEY; AGENTIC_OIDC_*

Also in the chain (not middleware): exception handler mapping NoProviderConfiguredError → HTTP 503 {detail} (S/app.py:146-155); per-route Depends(get_tenant_context) (tenant id from request header TENANT_HEADER, agentic_v2/core/tenant.py:64).

Auth details: - Public paths (S/auth.py:54-57,257): /metrics exactly; anything not starting with /api/; and /api/health*, /docs, /openapi.json, /redoc by prefix. Note /docs, /openapi.json and /redoc do not start with /api/, so they are already public via the non-/api rule. - API-key mode reads AGENTIC_API_KEY through get_secret() on every call (rotation without restart, S/auth.py:241-246). With no key and OIDC off, all routes are open (warning at S/lifespan.py:263). - OIDC mode (S/auth_oidc.py): validate_oidc_settings fails fast if issuer/audience/JWKS URL are missing (:81); OIDCAuthenticator verifies JWTs with PyJWT (_import_pyjwt, :375, lazy), JWKS cached; returns AuthenticatedActor {auth_type, subject, issuer, audience, tenant_id, organization_id}; 503 when the identity provider is unreachable (:298). AGENTIC_API_KEY remains a fallback credential (S/app.py:104-106 comment). - WebSocket auth is not covered by BaseHTTPMiddleware; _reject_websocket_connection re-implements origin + key + throttle + audit (S/websocket.py:520-600). It checks only the API key; OIDC bearer tokens are not validated on the WebSocket path (unverified: no OIDC reference in S/websocket.py). - Audit log: AuditLogger + AuditStore Protocol with NullAuditStore, FileAuditStore, RedisAuditStore (S/audit_log.py:61,77,90,144); built in lifespan from AUDIT_LOG_* settings.

Lifespan (S/lifespan.py:243-320): (1) warn if unauthenticated; (2) _validate_selected_adapter — AGENTIC_DEFAULT_ADAPTER (default langchain) must have its extras installed; (3) _enforce_rate_limiting_available; (4) _probe_llm_providers — error unless a provider key or AGENTIC_NO_LLM=1; (5) _install_smart_router — Redis-backed circuit-breaker state when REDIS_URL set, falling back to in-process on failure; (6) init ConnectionManager replay store (Redis/SQLite/memory); (7) build_audit_logger; yield; shutdown drains router Redis CAS tasks, closes replay store, shutdown_tracing().

SPA serving (S/spa.py): UI_DIST_DIR = agentic-workflows-v2/ui/dist; mounted only if UI_DIST_DIR.exists() (S/app.py:184).

docs.title: 3.6 Wire-format contracts (Pydantic → JSON Schema → TypeScript)
docs.text:
Pipeline (ADR-014, docs/adr/ADR-014-pydantic-wire-format.md):

  1. Pydantic models are the source of truth in agentic-workflows-v2/agentic_v2/contracts/ and server/models.py.
  2. python -m scripts.generate_ts_types (agentic-workflows-v2/scripts/generate_ts_types.py) dumps 8 schemas with TypeAdapter(...).json_schema() into agentic-workflows-v2/tests/schemas/ (indent=2, sort_keys=True).
  3. npm run generate:types (ui/scripts/generate-ts-types.mjs, json-schema-to-typescript) compiles each schema to ui/src/api/*.generated.ts, stripping property-level titles.
  4. CI job wire-format-drift (.github/workflows/ci.yml:347-408) regenerates both and fails on any diff.
Python contract Source file Committed schema (agentic-workflows-v2/tests/schemas/) Generated TS (ui/src/api/) TS consumer ExecutionEvent (discriminated union of 12 events) contracts/events.py events.schema.json events.generated.ts api/types.ts:267-269 StepResultRecord contracts/messages.py step_result.schema.json step_result.generated.ts api/types.ts:11 DAGResponse server/models.py dag_response.schema.json dag_response.generated.ts api/types.ts:23,46,49 WorkflowInputSchemaResponse server/models.py workflow_input_schema.schema.json workflow_input_schema.generated.ts api/types.ts:27 WorkflowEditorStep server/models.py workflow_editor_step.schema.json workflow_editor_step.generated.ts api/types.ts:33 RunsSummaryResponse server/models.py runs_summary.schema.json runs_summary.generated.ts api/types.ts:37,52 ChatRequest (model/tier overloads) contracts/chat.py chat_request.schema.json chat_request.generated.ts none ChatStreamEvent (token/route/media/done/error) contracts/chat.py chat_stream_event.schema.json chat_stream_event.generated.ts none

Verified unused: a search of ui/src, ui/tests and ui/e2e for each *.generated module name finds importers for the six rows above (all through api/types.ts) and none for chat_request.generated.ts or chat_stream_event.generated.ts. Chat types are hand-written in ui/src/api/types.ts (sections at lines ~783-835) and consumed by client.ts:4. They are therefore generated and drift-checked but not used; the Python↔TS chat contract is enforced only by regeneration, not by the compiler. Both files also appear in ui_inventory.unused_candidates.

Other schema artifacts and gates: - 23 per-class snapshot files in the same tests/schemas/ directory (WorkflowResult.json, StepResult.json, AgentMessage.json, ReviewReport.json, CodeReviewInput/Output.json, CodeGenerationOutput.json, TaskInput/Output.json, ChatMessage.json, ChatRequest.json, and the *Event.json files) are inputs to tests/test_schema_drift.py, which asserts the current model_json_schema() is a superset of the committed snapshot (additive changes pass, removals fail). They are not produced by generate_ts_types.py. - ui generate:types:check only diffs events.generated.ts (ui/package.json), narrower than the CI job, which diffs all generated files. - Hand-maintained wire types (not generated): ui/src/api/types.ts (settings, model packs, eval, datasets, chat), ui/src/api/hardware.ts; these mirror server/models.py, server/models_settings.py, server/evaluation.py by convention only. - Other contract surfaces: agentic_v2/contracts/ (TaskInput/Output, CodeReview*, WorkflowResult…), agentic_v2/artifact_contracts.py, agentic_v2/artifact_overlay.py.

docs.title: Env vars: .env.example vs code
docs.text:
Method: py_inventory.json modules[].env_vars (non-test modules, 62 distinct names) diffed against meta_inventory.json env_example_keys (99 names), then re-checked by substring search over non-test, non-docs source (.py/.yml/.toml/.ps1/.ts/.mjs). The AST extractor misses two read paths: (a) Settings pydantic fields (env name = upper-cased field name) and (b) get_secret("NAME") helper calls (e.g. AGENTIC_API_KEY, AGENTIC_CORS_ORIGINS). So a naive diff reports 63 "documented but unused" keys; the corrected breakdown is:

Documented in .env.example but never read in non-test source on main (6 keys, plus 1 stray):

Key Evidence Note AZURE_AI_SERVICES_ENDPOINT only .env.example hits Dead documentation AZURE_COGNITIVE_ENDPOINT only .env.example hits Dead documentation AZURE_OPENAI_DEPLOYMENT_0 only .env.example hits Indexed-suffix variant; code reads unsuffixed AZURE_OPENAI_DEPLOYMENT in tools/llm/ only LOCAL_MODEL_PATH only .env.example and prose docs (docs/architecture-runtime.md, docs/architecture-tools.md, docs/configuration.md) Doc-only VOYAGE_API_KEY only .env.example and docs/adr/ADR-035-rag-pipeline-architecture.md RAG embeddings planned/optional; no reader AGENTIC_MODEL_TIER_3, AGENTIC_MODEL_TIER_4 read only by agentic-workflows-v2/scripts/run_deep_research.py / .ps1; runtime reads TIER_1/2 (server/execution.py, langchain/models.py) Partially used provider parser artifact, not a key Ignore

All other .env.example keys are consumed, either by direct os.environ reads or via Settings fields (e.g. all AUDIT_LOG_*, REPLAY_*, REDIS_*, AGENTIC_OIDC_*, AGENTIC_APPROVAL_*, AGENTIC_REQUIRE_TOOL_APPROVAL, LOG_FORMAT, MAX_MCP_OUTPUT_TOKENS, AGENTIC_CHECKPOINTER_URL, AGENTIC_BLOCK_PRIVATE_IPS, AGENTIC_FILE_BASE_DIR, AGENTIC_MEMORY_PATH).

Read in code but absent from .env.example (used-but-undocumented):

Variable Read in Purpose AGENTIC_JUDGE_MODEL server/execution.py Model used by the LLM judge in post-run evaluation AGENTIC_MAX_COST_LANE models/model_registry.py Cost-lane ceiling for registry selection AGENTIC_UI_SETTINGS_PATH ui_settings.py Relocate .agentic_ui_settings.json (tests) HARDWARE_OVERRIDE_PATH server/routes/model_finder.py Hardware override file location OPENAI_API_BASE, OPENAI_ORG_ID langchain/model_builders.py, models/cloud_discovery.py, models/discovery_snapshot.py OpenAI-compatible base URL (note .env.example documents OPENAI_BASE_URL, a different name) / org LOCAL_AI_API_BASE_URL, LOCAL_OPENAI_BASE_URL langchain/model_builders.py, tools/llm/* Local OpenAI-compatible endpoints NOTEBOOKLM_MODEL, NOTEBOOKLM_GEMINI_MODEL langchain/model_builders.py NotebookLM model selection CLAUDE_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY_0, AZURE_FOUNDRY_ENDPOINT_2, OLLAMA_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, PROMPTS_GH_RATE_LIMIT_STRATEGY tools/llm/* Root tools/ package only (provider adapters / limit checks) PROMPTEVAL_ALLOW_REMOTE, PROMPTS_CACHE_ENABLED, GEN_MODEL, REF_MODEL, REV_MODEL, PYTHONIOENCODING tools/core/*, tools/llm/llm_client.py Root tools/ package only

Documentation-adjacent gaps among documented keys: .env.example documents OLLAMA_HOST, OLLAMA_API_KEY, LMSTUDIO_HOST, LM_API_TOKEN, DIGITALOCEAN_TOKEN, GITHUB_TOKEN; their readers go through provider tables and get_secret, not literal os.environ calls, so they were not re-verified one by one (unverified).

File Key facts ui/vite.config.ts Dev proxy /api -> VITE_API_PROXY_TARGET (default http://localhost:8010); /ws proxied with ws: true but the client bypasses it in dev (see 4.4). docs.title: 4.4 State and data layer
docs.text: Layer Implementation Evidence HTTP client Single module api/client.ts (695 LOC, 48 exported functions). BASE = "/api"; private fetchJSON<T>() wraps fetch(resolveRequestUrl(url)) and throws on non-OK. No auth header handling visible in the client ((unverified) beyond the grep for credentials/X- which found none). ui/src/api/client.ts:54,67,79 Hardware override Separate small module api/hardware.ts (49 LOC) for the profile-override types; calls live in client.ts (/api/model-finder/profile-override GET/PUT/DELETE). ui/src/api/hardware.ts Hand-written types api/types.ts (774 LOC, 40 prod importers — the most imported module) re-exports the generated types and defines everything else, including ChatRequest/ChatStreamEvent. ui/src/api/types.ts Server state React Query for reads and mutations. Shared read hooks: useWorkflows (4 queries), useRuns (4 queries; refetchInterval: 5000 only when live), useDatasets (2), useBackendHealth (15 s poll when enabled). Page/panel-local useQuery/useMutation in Dashboard, Editor, WorkflowDetail, ModelFinder, ProviderPanel, TierBoard, ModelPacksPanel, HardwareOverrideForm, ProviderProbeList, RunConfigForm, RunDetailPanel, RunComparePanel, Evaluations. Query keys seen: runs, run-evaluation, model-packs, model-probe, model-recommendations, hardware-override. ui/src/hooks/*.ts, grep of useQuery( WebSocket api/websocket.ts connectExecutionStream(runId, onEvent, {maxRetries=5, retryDelayMs=1000, pathPrefix="execution", onRetriesExhausted}) -> ws(s)://<host>/ws/execution/{runId}. Exponential backoff 1/2/4/8/16 s (31 s total), retry counter resets on open, malformed frames logged and dropped. In dev it connects directly to VITE_API_PROXY_TARGET because Vite's proxy drops WS upgrades. Consumed only by hooks/useWorkflowStream.ts. ui/src/api/websocket.ts:9-93 Stream reducer useWorkflowStream (216 LOC) accumulates run state; server replays its buffer on reconnect so duplicates are dropped by wire-key (comments at lines ~67-75). E2E reconnect.spec.ts covers drop-and-replay. ui/src/hooks/useWorkflowStream.ts SSE sendChat() (client.ts:498) does POST /api/chat with fetch + res.body.getReader() (SSE over fetch, abortable); used only by ChatPlaygroundPanel. ui/src/api/client.ts:447-545 Client-only state useCli context (CLI strip), useGoNav, useHotkeys, useTheme (data-theme attribute), PackBuilder draft reducer (packDraft.ts). No Redux/Zustand. ui/src/hooks, ui/src/components/models/pack-builder Feature flag Compile-time __AGENTIC_ENABLE_WORKFLOW_BUILDER__ (Vite define) read by parseBooleanFlag. Production builds hide /workflows/:name/edit unless the env flag is set at build time. ui/vite.config.ts, ui/src/config/featureFlags.ts Tracing initTracing() first in main.tsx; no-op unless VITE_OTEL_ENABLED=true. ui/src/main.tsx:10, ui/src/telemetry/tracing.ts

Generated file LOC Consumed by Verdict events.generated.ts 181 api/types.ts used step_result.generated.ts 70 api/types.ts used dag_response.generated.ts 93 api/types.ts used workflow_input_schema.generated.ts 96 api/types.ts used workflow_editor_step.generated.ts 66 api/types.ts used runs_summary.generated.ts 30 api/types.ts used chat_request.generated.ts 185 nobody emitted + drift-checked, never imported chat_stream_event.generated.ts 56 nobody emitted + drift-checked, never imported

CI wire-format-drift (ci.yml:347-411) regenerates and diffs all 8 files (lines 400-407 list them), but api/types.ts hand-defines ChatRequestBase, ModelChatRequest, TierChatRequest, ChatRequest, ChatStreamEvent instead of importing the generated ones. docs.title: 5.1.2 YAML schema as implemented
docs.text:
Two parsers read the same files; they do not accept the same keys.

Key Native loader workflows/loader.py (WorkflowLoader._parse_step, line 587) LangChain parser langchain/config.py (StepConfig, ~line 570) name, agent, description, depends_on, inputs, outputs yes yes input_contracts / output_contracts (kind code_artifact, ADR-052) yes (validated via artifact_contracts) yes when compiled to predicate using engine/expressions.ExpressionEvaluator stored as string, evaluated by langchain/expressions.py loop_until, loop_max (int or ${...} expr; expr stored as sentinel 0 + loop_max_expr) yes yes tools (list; omitted = tier default, [] = none) yes (metadata["tools"]) yes prompt_file yes (metadata["prompt_file"]) yes model_override / model alias parsed into metadata, but no code under engine/ reads it yes (graph_wiring.py:1002, agents.py:137) persona ignored yes (personas.py, graph_wiring.py:1011) observers, model_params ignored yes

Top-level keys common to both: name, description, version, capabilities{inputs,outputs}, inputs{type,description,required,default,enum}, outputs{from,optional}, evaluation{rubric_id,scoring_profile,criteria[]} (loader parses criteria with weight, critical_floor, formula_id, scale; weights may be derived), experimental, _templates (YAML anchors, ignored). A JSON Schema, agentic-workflows-v2/schemas/workflow.schema.json, is enforced in CI by scripts/validate-workflows.py (job validate-workflows).

Loader internals: WorkflowLoader.load(name) resolves <definitions_dir>/<name>.yaml|.yml, caches, builds a DAG (engine/dag.py), and calls resolve_agent (engine/agent_resolver.py) per step. resolve_agent infers tier from the prefix (tier0_..tier5_; unknown prefix defaults to tier 2), maps tier-0 names through TIER0_REGISTRY (exactly five: tier0_parser, tier0_process, tier0_counter, tier0_consensus, tier0_overlay), and builds an LLM step for tiers 1-5. Per-tier output caps: T1 4096, T2 8192, T3 16384, T4 16384, T5 32768 tokens (agent_resolver.py:96-100); tool loop bounded by MAX_TOOL_ROUNDS / MAX_TOOL_CALLS_PER_ROUND (engine/tool_execution.py).

docs.text:

flowchart TD
  brief["brieftier2_analyst"] --> R
  subgraph R["x5 parallel lanes: verification, concurrency, pragmatist, governance, adversary"]
    research["research_<judge>tier2_researchertools: file_read, search_files, web_search, http_get"]
  end
  R --> ext["extend_slatetier2_analyst, tools: nonemerges ALT-ids"]
  ext --> V

  end
  V --> vp["vote_picktier0_consensus"]
  vp -->|"when meets_threshold"| RT
  subgraph RT["x5 parallel, gated"]

  end
  RT --> vs["vote_stancetier0_consensus"]
  vs --> syn["synthesistier3_synthesizerreport"]

Note the data-flow subtlety: extend_slate depends on all five research_* steps, so no verdict can start until the slowest researcher finishes (one convoy point). Each verdict/ratify step takes tools: [], so only research steps touch the repo or the web.

docs.title: 5.5 agentic-workflows-v2/evals/swe_ab/ (152 files)
docs.text:
What it is: a paired A/B experiment asking whether ARP's multi-step review-loop workflow fixes more SWE-bench defects than a single coder call (evals/swe_ab/README.md). Arm A = workflows/swe_fix_direct.yaml (parse then patch); Arm B = workflows/swe_fix_review_loop.yaml (parse, root cause, draft, regression review, revise, verify). Same model, temperature, seed and rubric (swe_fix_v1); paid credentials are stripped from the child environment. It drives ARP as a subprocess through bridge.py and imports only agentic_evalkit in run_ab.py (one-way boundary).

Runnable status: not run here (needs Docker + Bash). CI never runs containers or k6; it only re-renders the report and compares committed numbers. The gate therefore compares a stale committed capture to a baseline derived from the same capture (it passes by construction until someone commits a new run).

docs.title: 6.6 Formal methods (proofs/)
docs.text:
• Toolchain: proofs/lean-toolchain = leanprover/lean4:v4.34.0. No Mathlib or Batteries (proofs/README.md).
  • Files: Main.lean, Scheduler.lean, Scheduler/Validate.lean, lakefile.toml, lake-manifest.json, README.md. About 116 top-level declarations (theorem, lemma, def, axiom, structure, inductive at column 0) across the three .lean files (grep count).
  • sorry: the two grep hits in Scheduler.lean (lines 2537-2538) sit in doc comments and are not proof terms (grep-based). lakefile.toml sets warningAsError, so real sorry fails the build.
  • Scope (README): the four ADR-060 scheduler guarantees are proved for a Lean model of dag_executor.py over every legal completion order. The Python code is not proved. Linkage is seeded replay on sampled schedules only.
  • Outstanding (README "Outstanding proof obligations", line 271 onward): DAG.get_execution_order (Kahn's algorithm) is not modelled; legality of FIRST_COMPLETED batches is checked per replayed trace (checkLegal), not proved for asyncio; timeout cleanup is covered by timeout_fails_closed.
  • lean-proofs.yml: timeout 20 min on PR, 60 otherwise (line 48). Steps: lake build in proofs/; replay pytest (tests/engine/test_dag_executor_lean_replay.py); exhaustive replay of small plans (test_dag_executor_lean_exhaustive.py); differential test (tests/test_orchestrator_dag_differential.py); a nightly exhaustive run of 4-step plans with 900s timeout (line 90, schedule gating unverified); axiom audit allowing propext and Quot.sound (lines 61-63).
